clauses.heading: 6.1 Registration
clauses.text: Each department must register every widget before it is put into service.

clauses.heading: 6.1 Registration
clauses.text: The register must record the owner, the location, the model and the firmware version of each widget.

clauses.heading: 6.2 Risk assessment
clauses.text: Departments must complete a widget risk assessment before a widget is put into service.

clauses.heading: 6.2 Risk assessment
clauses.text: The widget risk assessment must be updated when the purpose of the widget changes.

clauses.heading: 6.3 Calibration
clauses.text: Widgets must be calibrated at least once a year.

clauses.heading: 6.3 Calibration
clauses.text: Calibration results must be reviewed by a qualified technician.

clauses.heading: 6.3 Calibration
clauses.text: Faulty widgets must be removed from service until they are repaired.

clauses.heading: 6.4 Records
clauses.text: Operators must retain the calibration log for two years.

clauses.heading: 6.5 Transparency and reporting
clauses.text: Clients are informed when a widget is used to process their request.

clauses.heading: 6.5 Transparency and reporting
clauses.text: Departments report annually on the number of widgets in service. The report covers the fiscal year.
